scoring_justification: The agent outputs computed Poisson ratio values in a CSV; the checker verifies them against the known analytic formula (1-2α²)/(3-2α²) with a tolerance of 0.02. No richer artifact to recompute from is available, so direct result comparison against the paper's closed-form result is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference analytic formula for Poisson ratio
hidden_assets.generation_method: Closed-form expression derived and reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: It is a standard mathematical formula directly stated in the paper, not a fabricated dataset.

outputs.description: CSV file with columns 'alpha' and 'nu_P' giving the Poisson ratio as a function of the roughness parameter α.
